details:
**Import from the Share Sheet**
- Share a single audio file and choose Importone.
- Convert compatible audio to .m4r entirely on-device, then choose a name.
- Watch progress in a compact rounded blur card.

**Waveform Crop Editor**
- Audio longer than 40 seconds opens an on-device waveform editor.
- Scrub a stable, cached waveform to choose the selection.
- Drag either outer bracket to shorten or extend the crop, up to 40 seconds.
- Hold either bracket to zoom in, then drag to fine-tune the crop.
- Preview just the selected portion before importing.

**Manage Custom Ringtones**
- View imported tones in a simple text list with the same regular font as the native settings controls.
- Swipe left to rename, crop, or remove a tone, or tap it to open the same actions.
- Crop existing tones with the same waveform editor; Save Crop overwrites their audio while preserving the name, identifier and sound assignments.
- Renaming preserves its native tone identifier.
- Tones assigned to a sound are protected from deletion until you select a replacement.

**Sounds & Haptics**
- Imported tones appear in a separate Custom Ringtones section in the native tone pickers.
- Set your ringtone or alert tone in Settings → Sounds & Haptics.
- Open Sounds & Haptics using its separate preferences button.

**Preferences**
- Enable or disable Importone from Settings.

Requires a rootless jailbreak on iOS 15 or later. Tested on iOS 16.2 with Dopamine. Other versions require device testing. Audio must be unprotected. Imports are limited to 40 seconds after cropping and 10 MB after conversion. Source files may be up to 100 MB.
